items.title: ICICI Lombard Q2 net profit growth 15.5%; Rs 7 dividend announced
items.description: ICICI Lombard General Insurance achieved a net profit of ₹946 crore in the second quarter of FY2023, reflecting a 15.5% increase. The insurer reported strong performance in its motor and commercial segments, contributing to this growth. Gross premium income increased by 3% to ₹6,792 crore compared to the previous year. In addition, the company declared a dividend of ₹7 per share for the first half of the financial year.

items.title: Canara Bank net profit up 8.4%, treasury losses weigh
items.description: Canara Bank experienced an 8.4% year-on-year increase in net profit, reaching ₹5,175 crore for Q2 FY27. The bank's improvement in asset quality contributed to this profit growth, alongside core income expansion. However, mark-to-market losses from rising bond yields limited higher earnings outcomes. Its gross non-performing assets ratio also improved, declining to 1.3% from both the previous quarter and last year.

items.title: Orient Electric Q2 profit jumps two-fold to Rs 27 crore, revenue rises 25% YoY
items.description: Orient Electric Ltd has revealed a remarkable increase in net profit, soaring to Rs 27.06 crore in Q2 FY27, marking a more than two-fold jump from Rs 12.06 crore in the same quarter of the previous year. Additionally, the company reported a 25.15 percent growth in revenue from operations, totaling Rs 879.34 crore, with Electrical Consumer Durables revenue up by 24.85 percent to Rs 550.5 crore.

items.title: Nestle India Q2 Results: Standalone profit jumps 36% YoY to Rs 1,027 crore, revenue rises 20%
items.description: In the second quarter of FY27, Nestle India achieved a remarkable standalone net profit of Rs 1,027 crore, marking a substantial 36% increase from last year's Rs 753 crore. Revenue from operations soared to Rs 6,788 crore, a 20% rise from Rs 5,644 crore. However, despite these impressive results, shares fell by 7% to Rs 1,260 on the NSE, reflecting a mixed market response.

items.title: Jio Financial Services Q2 Results: PAT drops 51% yoy to Rs 340 crore; NII up 132%
items.description: Jio Financial Services reported a 51% year-on-year decline in Q2 FY27 profit to Rs 340 crore, despite total income rising 132% and net interest income surging 165%. Its NBFC business delivered 140% profit growth amid expanding financial services operations.

items.title: Indian Bank, UCO Bank lead Q2 profit growth as treasury income slumps
items.description: Indian Bank, UCO Bank, South Indian Bank and Karur Vysya Bank reported double-digit Q2 profit growth, supported by core income and loan expansion. However, rising bond yields hurt treasury earnings, while improving asset quality and provisions shaped quarterly performance.

items.title: Tech Mahindra announces 1:1 bonus issue, Rs 15 interim dividend; check record date
items.description: Tech Mahindra announced a 1:1 bonus share issue and Rs 15 interim dividend as it celebrated its 40th anniversary. The company expects bonus shares to be credited by December 15, 2026, subject to approvals, with October 23 as dividend record date.

items.title: Tech Mahindra Q2 Results: Net profit jumps 33% YoY to Rs 1,586 crore; co declares Rs 15/share dividend, 1:1 bonus issue
items.description: Tech Mahindra Q2 Results: Along with the earnings, Tech Mahindra's board declared an interim dividend of Rs 15 per equity share of face value Rs 5 each, equivalent to 300%, for the financial year 2026-27. It also approved a 1:1 bonus issue, under which shareholders will receive one bonus equity share for every existing equity share held, subject to the applicable terms and conditions.

items.title: Wipro Q2 Results: Net profit declines marginally to Rs 3,201 crore, but revenue rises 9% YoY
items.description: Wipro Q2 Results: Wipro reported a 1.4% year-on-year decline in Q2FY27 net profit to Rs 3,201 crore, while revenue rose 9.1% to Rs 24,752.7 crore. IT services revenue increased 0.3% to $2,611.5 million, while operating margin expanded 0.5 percentage points sequentially to 16.5%. The company expects IT services revenue to decline up to 1.5% or grow 0.5% sequentially in Q3FY27.

items.title: Tata Communications Q2 results: Net profit jumps 86% YoY to Rs 341 crore; revenue rises 10%
items.description: Tata Communications reported an 86.3% year-on-year jump in consolidated net profit to Rs 341 crore in Q2FY27, while revenue rose 9.6% to Rs 6,688 crore. EBITDA increased 21.1% to Rs 1,422 crore, reflecting improved operating performance.

items.title: IIFL Finance Q2 profit nearly doubles to Rs 805 crore; AUM rises 38%
items.description: IIFL Finance reported a significant increase in profit after tax for the quarter, rising to Rs 805 crore. This growth was attributed to stronger operating leverage and reduced loan losses during the period. The company's assets under management also rose substantially to Rs 1.24 lakh crore, primarily due to growth in gold loans.

items.title: L&T Finance Q2 net profit rises 33% to Rs 975 crore
items.description: L&T Finance reported a 33% increase in consolidated net profit for the quarter ending September 30, 2026. The company's consolidated loan book rose 28% year-on-year to reach Rs 1.36 lakh crore. Net interest margin improved to 10.48%, while total income increased by 26% to Rs 5,484 crore. Asset quality also showed improvement, with gross non-performing loans declining to 2.7%.
